role: One post-open Case 19 frame-zero mechanism gate for a deterministic solver-native two-component block Galerkin correction. It is not component weighting, per-rig component selection, an endpoint blend, a learned predictor, a threshold search, a full-sequence result, or a resource result.
scientific_question: Can two fixed signed detector-component residual blocks generate a second solver-native Krylov direction that reaches every frozen Case 19 frame-zero absolute and K16-matched gate at the same 15A+15A^T cost as ordinary K15, when K15 and all cheaper controls remain incomplete?
physical_hypothesis: A global PCGLS normal step sums the two detector components before preconditioning, even though the reported camera model maps the two signed detector axes through different geometry rows. Applying the exact adjoint separately to both complete signed component residual blocks and solving their joint two-dimensional projected span retains component-specific solver response without selecting a component, changing the observation metric, smoothing a field, or reading truth.
design_evidence_boundary: Case 19 and v244-v260 are already open. V259 reported component localization only after its camera-priority classification, and v260 consumed the authorized camera-weighting diagnostic. V261 does not read any v259 per-rig attribution array and does not tune from v260 arrays. No v261 Case 19 field, residual, coefficient, metric, pass count or gate value may be computed before this protocol, core, runner, independent validator and tests are committed. Synthetic unit tests do not read Case 19.

frozen_data_and_geometry.camera_roster: For each rig use the first nine stable IDs in the v209 order, then sort IDs in ascending ASCII order before operator construction.
frozen_data_and_geometry.preprocessing: Reuse the exact v248 frame-zero parser, float64 rectilinear interpolation, one-voxel truth support and active-cell truth gauge.
frozen_data_and_geometry.truth_use: CFD truth generates the synthetic observation and scores four veto metrics only. It never enters K13, component partitioning, adjoints, Galerkin coefficients, controls, depth or stopping.

unique_primary.name: canonical_camera_zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k13_signed_detector_component_block_galerkin2
unique_primary.base: Run zero-start reported-geometry diagonal-Jacobi PCGLS K13 and retain x13 and r13.
unique_primary.component_partition: Reshape r13 exactly as [9 cameras,16 rows,16 columns,2 detector components]. Define r0 by retaining every signed component-0 entry and zeroing component 1; define r1 conversely. Both complete blocks are always used, with no score, component selection, camera identity, threshold or normalization.
unique_primary.block_directions: For j in {0,1}, compute n_j=A^T r_j, p_j=M^{-1} n_j using the frozen reported-geometry Jacobi inverse, and q_j=A p_j. This costs exactly two A and two A^T after K13.
unique_primary.galerkin_solve: Let Q=[q0,q1], G=Q^T Q and b=Q^T r13. Scale G to its unit-diagonal correlation matrix and use a complete float64 symmetric eigensolve. If min_eigenvalue <= 1e-12*max_eigenvalue, execution is invalid. With no ridge, pseudoinverse, coefficient clipping or fallback, solve G alpha=b and set x=x13+[p0,p1]alpha and r=r13-Q alpha.
unique_primary.ledger: K13 costs 13A+13A^T; the two fixed component blocks cost 2A+2A^T. All split and 2x2 Galerkin algebra adds 0A+0A^T.

controls.name: canonical_camera_zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k15
controls.definition: Same-cost unmodified reported-geometry diagonal-Jacobi PCGLS K15.

controls.name: canonical_camera_zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k14
controls.definition: Cheaper unmodified reported-geometry diagonal-Jacobi PCGLS K14.

forbidden_search: No component subset, component score, component weight, camera identity, camera subset, threshold, normalization, rank, correlation floor, ridge, pseudoinverse, coefficient clipping, coefficient box, blend, correction multiplier, depth, preconditioner, rig, metric, tolerance or fallback search is allowed after freeze. Do not read v259 per-rig attribution arrays to choose a block and do not replace the detector-component partition with frequency or camera blocks.

accuracy_gate.two_replica_envelope: For every arm, rig and metric take max(formal_metric, independent_metric) before any absolute, matched, tail or control decision. Passing therefore requires both numerical implementations to pass every gate.
accuracy_gate.control_dominance: If same-cost K15 or either cheaper v258/K14 control passes all thirteen absolute and K16-matched envelope cells, component-block-specific headroom is not isolated.

independent_validation.method: A second program must rebuild observations and Jacobi, independently implement K13, signed component masks, both exact adjoints/forwards and the full two-direction solve using a direct Cholesky system rather than the formal eigensolve, all controls, physical replay, metrics and calls without importing the formal v261 core or runner. It seals predictions before reading formal scientific arrays.
independent_validation.adjudication: Continuous cross-implementation differences are reported and bounded, but the scientific decision uses the componentwise worst-case metric envelope rather than exact floating equality.

decision_order: Any source, parent, input, shape, finite, component-partition, full-rank, normal-equation, residual-orthogonality, projection-reconstruction, permutation, call-ledger, replay, seal or cross-implementation closure failure gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_COMPONENT_BLOCK_GALERKIN_FRAME_ZERO_V261.

If the unique primary fails any of the thirteen absolute or K16-matched worst-case-envelope cells, conclude FAIL_CASE19_COMPONENT_BLOCK_GALERKIN_FRAME_ZERO_V261 and close this exact two-component block-Krylov mechanism without a full sequence run.
If the primary passes all thirteen but same-cost K15 or cheaper v258/K14 also passes all thirteen envelope cells, conclude PASS_CASE19_FRAME_ZERO_BUT_COMPONENT_BLOCK_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ISOLATED_V261.

Only if the primary passes 13/13 absolute and matched envelope cells, all same-or-lower-cost controls remain incomplete, every ledger and independent check passes may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE19_COMPONENT_BLOCK_GALERKIN_FRAME_ZERO_HEADROOM_V261 and authorize one separately frozen 429-cell sequence gate.
failure_action: Close the exact two signed detector-component residual blocks plus full two-direction Galerkin solve without changing the partition, adding blocks, selecting components, tuning the solve, changing depth, or adding a learned model. Do not rescue with component/frequency/camera weights, larger block Krylov, endpoint blending, CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet or GPU.
